purpose: Deep public-domain information discovery using independent digital, scientific, geophysical and transportation clocks.

candidates.name: Historical issuer web-state change × disclosure arrival
candidates.next_gate: capture timestamp semantics, crawl lag characterization, immutable issuer URL map, future-capture invariance
candidates.hypothesis: Publicly visible issuer web-state transitions may contain operational or disclosure timing not present in filing metadata alone.
candidates.construction: Use a frozen issuer URL set and a mechanically defined Common Crawl content-state change using CDXJ/WARC capture timestamps; crawl lag and capture gaps remain explicit and later captures cannot alter earlier states.

candidates.name: Open-source vulnerability disclosure shock × software issuer exposure
candidates.next_gate: advisory publication/updated timestamps, fixed package-to-issuer graph, withdrawn/revised advisory handling
candidates.hypothesis: Newly public package vulnerabilities may create a technology-risk information state before broad repricing.
candidates.construction: Translate fixed GitHub Advisory/OSV publication events through a pre-registered package-to-issuer exposure graph; publication, revision and withdrawal timestamps are distinct.

candidates.name: Flight-network disruption × exposed airline/airport ecosystem
candidates.next_gate: license/commercial-use eligibility, historical completeness, nightly-batch timing, fixed airport/issuer exposure graph
candidates.hypothesis: Observed aircraft/airport network disruptions may encode operational stress independently of market prices.
candidates.construction: Use fixed historical OpenSky nightly-batch flight states with a frozen airport/issuer exposure graph only if the required usage rights are available; occurrence time and batch-publication boundary remain distinct.

candidates.name: Marine/weather extreme × shipping and industrial exposure
candidates.next_gate: dataset-vintage stability, station/entity geography, update timing and revision semantics
candidates.hypothesis: Public ocean/weather state changes may create supply-chain and physical-operating shocks.
candidates.construction: Combine fixed NOAA ERDDAP scientific observations with a frozen geography/exposure graph; dataset-vintage, update and revision semantics must be preserved and next-session use is used when exact availability is unproven.

candidates.name: Seismic sequence state × extractive/utility exposure
candidates.next_gate: sequence-definition freeze independent of returns, event update timestamps, fixed facility geography
candidates.hypothesis: Deterministic earthquake-sequence transitions may alter operating-location states beyond a single-event trigger.
candidates.construction: Construct sequences from USGS event-time and updated-after fields with a frozen sequence definition and facility geography; future returns do not determine membership and later event updates cannot rewrite prior public states.

candidates.name: Science-output burst × issuer technology exposure
candidates.next_gate: deposit/publication timing, affiliation mapping, duplicate/venue correction and pre-frozen domain taxonomy
candidates.hypothesis: Accelerating public research output around a fixed technology domain may capture innovation intensity.
candidates.construction: Construct a fixed publication-burst state from Crossref/OpenAlex public metadata with a pre-frozen affiliation/domain taxonomy; deposit/publication timing and duplicate/correction semantics are preserved.

candidates.name: Space-weather state transition × infrastructure sensitivity
candidates.next_gate: issue/correction/cancellation clock, fixed exposure taxonomy and revision-safe PIT
candidates.hypothesis: Alert/warning transitions may contain external operational information for communication, power and navigation-sensitive firms.
candidates.construction: Use fixed NOAA SWPC issue/correction/cancellation events with a frozen exposure taxonomy and revision-safe PIT; cancellations affect state only from their own public issue boundary.

candidates.name: Web-corpus × security-disclosure collision state
candidates.next_gate: separate source clocks, collision definition frozen ex ante, no same-source duplicate information
candidates.hypothesis: The interaction between public web-state change and formal security disclosure may reveal distinct dissemination phases.
candidates.construction: Construct a deterministic two-clock collision state from Common Crawl and GitHub Advisory events using separately defined public boundaries; the collision relation is frozen ex ante and no search over collision windows is allowed.
